events.verdict: Fears (NOP) briefly grasps Kornet's (SAS) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Vassell (SAS) contests Poole's (NOP) shot attempt and the contact that occurs to his front is marginal.
Vassell (SAS) makes direct and clean contact with the ball during Williamson's (NOP) driving shot attempt.
Castle (SAS) jumps forward to contest Poole's (NOP) play at the basket when marginal body contact occurs after Poole's release.
Williamson (NOP) and Wembanyama (SAS) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Wembanyama (SAS) steps out of bounds with his right foot before releasing the pass.
Wembanyama (SAS) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Kornet (SAS) slides his arm off Williamson (NOP) as he enters his upward shooting motion, and the contact is marginal.
Wembanyama (SAS) brings his hands towards Murphy III (NOP) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Wembanyama (SAS) reaches forward and makes contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Castle (SAS) releases the inbound pass within 5 seconds.
Williamson (NOP) rests and quickly removes his hand from Wembanyama (SAS) when marginal contact occurs at the start of Wembanyama's drive.
Queen (NOP) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Wembanyama's (SAS) arm.
Queen (NOP) does not maintain a legal guarding position when he initiates contact with Castle's (SAS) arm and upper body, which affects his driving shot attempt.

Williamson's (NOP) left foot is slightly outside the frame of his body when marginal contact occurs with Castle (SAS) during the pick. This contact does not impede Castle's ability to defend the ballhandler.
Poole (NOP) switches his pivot before his dribble.
Barnes (SAS) and Murphy III (NOP) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Barnes (SAS) initiates the first illegal contact by extending both hands into Fears' (NOP) front, affecting his SQBR before any further contact occurs with Barnes.
After the marginal body contact from Barnes (SAS), Kornet (SAS) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Williamson's (NOP) driving shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Castle's (SAS) pass goes out of bounds.
Fears (NOP) brings his arm toward Castle's (SAS) path and marginal contact occurs as Castle crosses midcourt.
Jones (NOP) commits a take foul on Castle (SAS).
Kornet (SAS) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Poole's (NOP) driving shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Castle (SAS) touches the ball while he is out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to NOP.
Champagnie (SAS) is moving alongside Fears' (NOP) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together at the start of the drive.
Poole (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Barnes (SAS) prior to incidental contact occurring with Barnes' wrist thereafter.
